translations.web: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
translations.bsb: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
translations.kjv: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
translations.asv: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.
